about.title: À propos
about.body: Je photographie sérieusement depuis quelques années, attiré avant tout par la géométrie et les lignes épurées de l'architecture. Je cherche le cadrage qui réduit un espace à ses formes essentielles — cette découverte, plus que tout, est ce qui me satisfait. Chaque photo est une tentative de progresser un peu par rapport à la précédente. Les tirages que vous trouverez ici naissent de ce plaisir personnel, pas d'un plan établi.

sections.heading: Data Controller
sections.body: The data controller for information collected on this site is Samer (Samer Fine Art), reachable at samer.fineart1999@gmail.com. I currently operate as an individual, without a registered VAT business.

sections.heading: Data Collected
sections.body: When you make a purchase, I collect: name, email address, shipping address. Payment details (card number, etc.) never pass through or are stored by me in any way: they are handled entirely by Stripe, our payment processor.

sections.heading: Purpose of Processing
sections.body: The data collected is used exclusively to: process your order, communicate with the print fulfilment provider (Prodigi) for production and shipping, and respond to any support requests.

sections.heading: Legal Basis
sections.body: Processing is based on the performance of the sales contract (GDPR art. 6.1.b) — your data is necessary to complete the order you requested.

sections.heading: Data Recipients
sections.body: Your data is shared exclusively with the service providers necessary to complete your order: Stripe (payments), Prodigi (printing and shipping), Vercel (site hosting). No data is sold, shared, or used for advertising purposes by me.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: Order-related data is retained for as long as necessary to fulfil the order and to comply with any legal obligations (e.g. tax-related), and in any case no longer than 10 years.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of your personal data at any time by writing to samer.fineart1999@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses only technical cookies necessary for checkout to function (managed by Stripe). No profiling or advertising tracking cookies are used.

sections.heading: Made to Order
sections.body: Each print is produced specifically after your order, in the size you chose. Production time is generally 2-5 business days before shipping.

sections.heading: Shipping
sections.body: Prints are shipped with tracked courier from the Prodigi lab closest to you worldwide. You'll receive an email with a tracking link as soon as your order ships. Prints from 20×30cm upward ship rolled in a protective rigid tube.

sections.heading: Right of Withdrawal
sections.body: Because each print is a personalised product, made to order in the size you chose, the standard 14-day right of withdrawal for off-the-shelf products does not apply (Italian Consumer Code, art. 59, letter c — the EU equivalent applies for other member states).

sections.heading: Damage & Defects
sections.body: If your print arrives damaged in transit or has a printing defect, you're entitled to a free replacement. Contact me within 14 days of receipt at samer.fineart1999@gmail.com, with a photo of the damage/defect and your order number.

sections.heading: Size Tolerance
sections.body: The sizes shown for each format are approximate: your print is made at the lab closest to you worldwide, rounded to the nearest inch or centimetre depending on the production region. A variation of a few millimetres from the nominal size is normal and not a defect.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any question about an order, shipping, or return, write to samer.fineart1999@gmail.com.
